On the list 1 straight settlement day since 11/20. Day 13 = Wed 12/9 if it stays on (Thu 12/10 if counted from each list's next open). After day 13, Rule 203(b)(3) makes a clearing firm buy shares to close out a fail to deliver it carried on every one of those days; the buying may come from day 11 (Mon 12/7) and must start by the next open (SEC staff FAQ 6.5, 6.7). Rule 204 already requires a fail in any stock to be closed out 1 to 3 settlement days after settlement, so fails generally do not last 13 (SEC staff); for a Rule 144 sale the count is 35, not 13. Fails to deliver only, not every short position. A rule date — it says nothing about price. Not advice.
